title: BA1/1745/2016 of Akeel Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
BA1 No.1745 of 2016
U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. B.M.Pingal, Advocate present for the
applicant.
Mr. V.K.Gemini Deputy Advocate
General, present for the State.
Applicant Akeel, seeks bail in connection
with F.I.R No. 293 of 2016 under sections 379
and 411of I.P.C, P.S Ramnagar, District Nainital.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and
considered the grounds taken up in the bail
application.
 An F.I.R was lodged against three
unknown persons alleging there in that they pick-pocketed and took away the wallet of the reporter
stealthily. The reporter was going to Chamunda
Hospital in connection with treatment of his son
and since the accused persons took away a sum
of Rs.20,000/-, which were meant for the
treatment of his son, therefore, his son was
deprived of suitable medical treatment.
The applicant was arrested soon thereafter.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted
that the applicant is ready to return a sum of Rs.
6,170/- to the reporter, which money was
allegedly recovered from his possession after 21
days of the incident.
 Considering the fact that applicant is ready
to return Rs 6,170/-, which was allegedly
recovered from his possession after 21 days of
the incident, this Court is of the opinion that the
applicant should be granted bail. Learned counsel
for the applicant also submitted that the applicant
is ready to furnish reliable sureties to the
satisfaction of the court concerned.

If the money is returned by the applicant to
the reporter, the same will not amount to his
confession and an order of conviction shall not be
recorded against him on the basis of such fact.
 If the money is not paid by the applicant to
the reporter within three weeks from the date of
his release on bail, the complainant as well as the
State will be at liberty to move for cancellation of
his bail.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
 16.12.2016
NP
